title: She told me to add more color.
scene: 老师让他在画上加东西。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did the teacher say about your drawing?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me to add more color.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I added blue to the sky.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She told me to show the class tomorrow.

variations: "add more color" 换 "draw it bigger"；"blue to the sky" 换 "a sun in the corner"。
